deduplication: Only identical substantive obligations: preserve lexicographically smallest candidate identity as representative and list duplicates with rationale. Sharing a package is insufficient.

extraction.backlog: One candidate per complete canonical B-XXXX record. Retain exact committed UTF-8 text, title and metadata. No invented subtask decomposition.
extraction.roadmap: One candidate per Markdown heading level 2 through 6, containing its heading and text up to the next heading of any level. Empty navigation sections remain inventoried. No synthesized obligations or recombined sentences.

future_seed: SHA256 of domain-separated canonical inputs: devtools-development-extension-v1, starting HEAD, exact original and expanded freeze digests, canonical inventory digest. No manually chosen seed or reroll.
requirements: Not previously evaluated and not a confirmation/reserve task
Concrete repository-changing engineering assignment with correctness defined by existing source wording
Self-contained without inventing unresolved semantics or requiring inaccessible external state
Substantive work not already completely implemented
Primary purpose independent of retrieval evaluation, benchmark/gold/population/verifier machinery
scope_rationale: Every canonical backlog record plus the complete accepted roadmap; selected by source authority, not retrieval mechanism.
selection: Only after complete eligibility inventory; >=16 eligible choose16, 8..15 chooseall, <8 stop without population freeze/commit/push.
